name: Volumetric Smoke Raymarching with Voxel Grid and FBM Noise
definition: A GPU-based volumetric rendering technique that renders smoke clouds using a voxel grid density field combined with procedural FBM noise, performing raymarching with Henyey-Greenstein scattering and Beer-Lambert absorption.
summary: A GPU technique rendering smoke via voxel grid density and FBM noise, distinguished by combining base voxel data with high-frequency procedural detail using a sphere SDF falloff.
